cohort: 161 women at more than 34 weeks of gestation, between 20 to 40 years of age, with previous cesarean section at least two years ago
finding: Unsuccessful TOLAC was associated with illiteracy, no prior vaginal delivery, induction of labor, fetal distress, meconium-stained liquor, prolonged labor, failed progress of labor, and scar disruption.
mod_finding: 59% of the women had a vaginal delivery after cesarean (VBAC) and 34.8% had a repeat cesarean delivery.
